series.name: Isolation Forest alone at the same cutoff

title: Rule Boosts Do the Flagging, and Precision Stays at 100 Percent
subtitle: Recall on 5,000 synthetic transactions per run, 3 seeds and 2 simulated clock start times. Precision was 1.000 in all 6 runs for the full gate
caption: The full gate flagged 2.9 to 3.2 percent of all traffic with zero false positives among normal and elevated normal transactions. The forest alone flagged 0 of 5,000 in every run. The clock start time made almost no difference.
